verdict.rationale: Shared team inboxes are a fair question for an email provider, so this axis applies. The evidence pack never documents shared mailboxes, shared folders or team channels with a common conversation state. The 'Logging in to multiple accounts' help article covers one user switching between their own accounts. JMAP's multi-account session object is only a developer building block, not a shared-inbox feature.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
